task_description: Add CLAUDE.md project setting to enable per-project customization of AI agent behavior by reading CLAUDE.md from project root and injecting into system prompt.

patterns.ui_toggle_pattern: Use Switch component from Radix UI with Label and description. Default to true using nullish coalescing (settings.useClaudeMd ?? true)
patterns.env_var_pattern: Check project.settings.useClaudeMd !== false, set env['USE_CLAUDE_MD'] = 'true' as string
patterns.file_loading_pattern: Use Path object with .exists() check, .read_text(encoding='utf-8'), return None on exceptions
patterns.i18n_pattern: Add keys to projectSections.general in settings.json: 'useClaudeMd' and 'useClaudeMdDescription'
patterns.system_prompt_injection: Append content with section header: '# Project Instructions (from CLAUDE.md)'

graphiti_mcp_toggle.description: Similar toggle pattern for Graphiti MCP server integration
